title: Titanic
synopsis: Southampton, April 1912. You're first class, engaged to a man who keeps a safe of secrets. The man you'll actually fall for is three decks below playing cards for a ticket.

nodes.text: The biggest ship ever built. White Star flags. You don't look at it the way the steerage does.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Try to feel the wonder.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Class—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your fiancé's smile is, on closer reading, ownership.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Tolerate.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Push back” back. Spirit shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The first-class dining room is a circus of forks.

choices.consequence: “Be charming” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Strategy.
There is no taking “Be honest” back. Truth shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You walk to the back at night, considering the water.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
“Step back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Caution.

nodes.text: A man named Jack talks you back from the rail. He sketches.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Curious—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Walk away.” The story records the instinct as “Class” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Beer, music, dancing without shoes.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Joy—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Sit and watch” back. Quiet shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Cal flips the table. He hits you, almost. You realize you cannot marry him.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategic—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Jack draws you wearing only the Heart of the Ocean. Cal will find the sketch.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Leave it for him.” The story records the instinct as “Defiant” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Cars in the hold. A handprint on a window.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Just be here” back. Present shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Plan.

nodes.text: 11:40 p.m. Bell. Frantic turn. The scrape is small. The water is fast.

choices.consequence: “Believe it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Real.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Hope.

nodes.text: The architect knows the ship will sink. He tells you to put on your lifebelt.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Hesitate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Women and children first. Cal forces you in. Jack is on the deck.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Live—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Step out.” The story records the instinct as “Choice” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You leap from the lifeboat back onto the ship. Jack runs to you.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Vow—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Look at the ship” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Cal, with a pistol. The corridors are flooding.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run” back. Survive shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Trick him” back. Cunning shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Water roars up the staircase. A clock chimes 2:00.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.
You commit to “Help others as you go.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Steerage is locked below. You and Jack break a bench from the floor.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Find another route.” The story records the instinct as “Strategic” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The stern rises out of the water. You hold the rail.

choices.consequence: “Climb the rail” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Plan.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Faith.

nodes.text: The ship splits. The stern drops. Cold takes everything.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.

nodes.text: A wooden door in the water. Jack pushes you onto it. He stays in.

choices.text: Hold his hand till he goes
choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.

nodes.text: Carpathia is hours away. You take the whistle from a frozen officer.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Blow it long.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Conserve.

nodes.text: You give your name as Rose Dawson. The reporters never find you.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Vow—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You live as Rose Dawson for the rest of your life. You travel. You ride horses. You learn to fly. At eighty-something, you sail to the wreck site and drop the diamond in.
Cal loses everything in 1929 and shoots himself. You read about it in the paper at breakfast. You finish the toast. You go on with your day.
You keep a small sketch in a tin. You speak to him sometimes, by water. You marry, eventually, a kind man. He does not, you tell him, replace Jack. He understands.
